summary: super-color ships Windows dropper that fetches and executes PE binaries from Discord CDN on any color API call
details: The package advertises itself as a colored-printing library, but its Color class methods (paint, print, __call__) invoke an internal _run_payload() helper that, on Windows, downloads two unsigned PE binaries from Discord CDN URLs (cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/... named AVKiller.exe and bedwars.exe) into %TEMP%\SolaceRuntime\ and launches them with DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW. The downloader spoofs a Chrome User-Agent, validates the fetched bytes carry an MZ header and exceed 4096 bytes, and falls back through urllib, curl, and certutil -urlcache -split -f (a known living-off-the-land binary) if the primary fetch fails. The first stage is named AVKiller.exe, consistent with antivirus-tampering, followed by execution of bedwars.exe. Any normal use of the documented color API on a Windows host triggers the dropper chain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
